I'll append one Results section to the batch 9 doc from the relay log and the CSV diff, and leave every other section and file alone.The doc already has a stub `## Results` that says the batch was not run. I'll replace that stub with the run summary so there is still only one Results section.**Detail**

`docs/cis-fix/batch-9.md` already ended with a `## Results` stub that said the batch had not run. A second heading would have left two Results sections, so that stub was replaced. No other section or file was edited.

The log `tools/relay/logs/batch-9-20261104-211507-results.txt` is a completed keep. PASTE 1 saw two LAN SSH sessions, kept the existing tar and `chage` backup, armed the 300-second timer, skipped apt because the packages were already installed, noted the leftover `common-*.pam-old` files, wrote the pwquality drop-in, faillock, pwhistory, `PASS_MAX_DAYS`, umask, and shell timeout file, and got `PAM-AUTH-UPDATE-OK`, an unchanged last-change date of Oct 29, 2026, `STACK-OK`, and `OK-batch-9-pending`. PASTE 2 came from a new session (`192.168.50.223:52674`), checked the stack again, stopped the timer, reset faillock for `aj`, and printed `OK-batch-9`. PASTE 3 was not used.

The CSV diff flips all 24 in-scope rules off FAIL, dated 2026-11-04, with evidence taken from those markers. Twenty are PASS. Four stay PASS (manual): password complexity (5.3.3.2.3), dictionary check (5.3.3.2.6), quality enforcement (5.3.3.2.7), and default umask (5.4.3.3). The umask row says the new setting was not live-checked in the snapshot. Rules that already passed were left as they were. The diff does not include `/etc` copies in this repo.

**Relay**

Batch 9 results are in `docs/cis-fix/batch-9.md` only (stub replaced, one `## Results`). Log `batch-9-20261104-211507`: `SKIP-apt-already`, `PAM-AUTH-UPDATE-OK`, `CHAGE-LAST-UNCHANGED` Oct 29 2026, `OK-batch-9-pending`, then new SSH `192.168.50.223:52674`, `TIMER-STOPPED`, `OK-batch-9`. PASTE 3 unused. CSV: 24 in-scope FAIL → PASS; four of those are PASS (manual): 5.3.3.2.3, 5.3.3.2.6, 5.3.3.2.7, 5.4.3.3 (umask not live-checked). Already-PASS rows untouched. No `/etc` mirror in that diff.

- Run `batch-9-20261104-211507`
